title: Conductor Workflow Definition (schemaVersion 1)
description: Canonical contract for a Workflow definition — the single versioned JSONB document stored in workflow_definitions.definition and validated in Java. Every consumer (WorkflowEngine, WorkflowDefinitionValidator, the no-code Builder, the MCP/CLI surface, and authoring skills) reads/writes THIS shape. This schema enforces STRUCTURAL rules (field types, enums, required keys, hard caps that are expressible per-array). SEMANTIC rules that span the document are enforced by WorkflowDefinitionValidator in Java and are listed under x-semantic-rules below; they are NOT expressible in JSON Schema alone.

schemaVersion.description: Version of THIS schema the definition targets. The validator routes on it. v1 only for now.

id.description: Stable, human-readable slug — the reference used everywhere (MCP, skills, seeds). Never a UUID. e.g. ENGINEERING, CONTENT_REVIEW.

area.description: Nav grouping slug. A single-Workflow Area renders flat (no double-nesting). A string on the definition, not a join table — adding an Area is a data change.

version.description: Monotonic version. In-flight Work Items pin to the version they started on; new Work Items bind the latest PUBLISHED.

state.description: Lifecycle state. Only a PUBLISHED version is bindable by Work Items; Builder edits accumulate in a DRAFT.

noun.description: Display noun for this Workflow's Work Items (e.g. Issue, Post, Campaign). 'Work Item' is the system default.

default_view.description: Default rendering of the Work Item list.

types.description: Allowed Work Item types (strings validated against this list, not a DB enum). e.g. PRD, FEATURE_REQUEST, BUG_REPORT.

asset_types.description: Allowed produced-output Asset types (e.g. github_pr, published_url, file). Extensible with zero schema change. Omit/empty if the Workflow produces no Assets.

metric.description: Optional Outcome Metric kept as a time series. null/absent means the Workflow opts out (e.g. Engineering).

statuses.description: Ordered stages. Hard cap: <= 10 (P0-2). Semantic: exactly one initial, >= 1 terminal, all non-terminal reach a terminal.

transitions.description: Allowed moves between statuses. Semantic caps: <= 5 transitions per source status, <= 3 review-gated transitions total.

triggers.description: What starts/advances Work Items on this Workflow. Reuses the existing automation engine's trigger types. Omit for a purely human-driven Workflow.

category.description: Lane grouping. 'terminal' statuses end the Work Item.

initial.description: Exactly one status across the definition must set this true (Java-enforced).

terminal.description: True for an end state. At least one required (Java-enforced). Must agree with category=terminal.

from.description: Source status id; must exist in statuses[] (Java-enforced).

to.description: Target status id; must exist in statuses[] (Java-enforced).

label.description: Human-readable action label shown to the doer (e.g. 'Submit for review').

requiresReview.description: When true, the engine BLOCKS this transition until a Review is recorded (P0-1.3 / P0-6). The one true behavior change vs. today's advisory reviews.

reviewOutcomes.description: Required when requiresReview is true: the allowed review verdicts (>= 2). Conditionally enforced below.

reviewerRole.description: Which existing project role approves this gate. No per-Workflow custom roles in v1.

steps.description: Automated actions on this transition. Hard cap: <= 3 per transition (P0-2).

allOf.description: requiresReview=true forces reviewOutcomes to be present (>= 2 outcomes).

kind.description: Step type. skill = run a Claude Code skill (driven locally, reported via MCP); http/notify/set_field/create_sub_items run on the existing automation engine. connector_fetch/connector_action are the post-v1 integration seam and are rejected by the v1 validator until implemented.

mode.description: BLOCKING holds the transition until the step is done; ASYNC is fire-and-forget. For a skill step, BLOCKING is an advisory convention the local driver honors (the engine does not run the skill).

type_version.description: Executor contract version, so an existing Workflow never breaks when a step type changes (n8n pattern).

skill.description: For kind=skill: the bindable skill id. Must exist in the skill registry (AC-P0-2.5, Java-enforced). e.g. conductor:implement.

config.description: Kind-specific configuration (e.g. http url/method, notify channel, set_field key/value, create_sub_items source list + concurrency cap). Shape validated per-kind by the executor.

type.description: manual (Run Now), schedule (cron), status_changed, or webhook. connector_event is the post-v1 integration seam.

cron.description: Required for type=schedule: a 5-field cron expression (parsed by Spring CronExpression).

timezone.description: Optional IANA timezone for a schedule trigger.

direction.description: Whether higher or lower observed values are better — drives top-performer/regression queries.

x-semantic-rules: At least one status is terminal (terminal=true and category=terminal).
Every non-terminal status can reach some terminal status via transitions (no dead-ends / unreachable statuses).
Every transition.from and transition.to references an id present in statuses[].
At most 5 transitions share the same from status.
Every step with kind=skill references a skill id present in the skill registry.
Only a state=PUBLISHED version is bindable by Work Items; DRAFT is editable but not bound.
schemaVersion routes validation; unknown schemaVersion is rejected.
connector_fetch/connector_action step kinds and connector_event triggers are reserved for post-v1 and rejected by the v1 validator.
